-------------------------------------------------
-- SURSA: app.StatPlataCO
-- TIP PLATA: AVANS CONCEDII (AVN)
-- BANCA: BCR
-------------------------------------------------

INSERT INTO app.SumaBCR
(
    Marca,
    Nume,
    CNP,
    Cont,
    Suma,
    TipPlata,

    Nume1,
    CNP1,
    Cont1,

    Luna,
    Anul,

    DataPlatii,
    DenumireFisier,

    Recreat,

    Valid,
    MesajValidare,

    CodSucursala,
    Status,

    CreatedDate
)

SELECT
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Date principale
    -------------------------------------------------
    spc.Marca,

    ISNULL(s.Nume,spc.Nume),

    s.CNP,

    cb.ContIBAN,

    spc.TotalAvans,

    @TipPlata,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Campuri export BCR
    -------------------------------------------------
    '"' + ISNULL(ISNULL(s.Nume,spc.Nume),'') + '"',

    '"' + ISNULL(s.CNP,'') + '"',

    '"' + ISNULL(cb.ContIBAN,'') + '"',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Perioada payroll
    -------------------------------------------------
    spc.Luna,

    spc.Anul,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Data platii
    -------------------------------------------------
    @DataPlatii,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Denumire fisier
    -- Exemplu: J160726AVN.bcr
    -------------------------------------------------
    @CodSucursala
    + FORMAT
      (
          CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE),
          'ddMMyy'
      )
    + @CodSursa
    + '.bcr',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Recreat
    -------------------------------------------------
    'NU',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Valid
    -- Ajung aici doar cardurile valide
    -------------------------------------------------
    CAST(1 AS BIT),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Mesaj validare
    -------------------------------------------------
    'OK',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Cod sucursala
    -------------------------------------------------
    spc.CodSucursala,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Status Draft
    -------------------------------------------------
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 Id
        FROM app.StatusCalcul
        WHERE Denumire = 'Draft'
    ),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.StatPlataCO spc

INNER JOIN app.CardBCR cb
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.Marca))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(spc.Marca))

LEFT JOIN app.Salariat s
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(s.Marca))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(spc.Marca))

   AND s.CodSucursala = spc.CodSucursala
   AND s.Luna = spc.Luna
   AND s.Anul = spc.Anul

WHERE spc.Luna = @Luna
  AND spc.Anul = @Anul
  AND spc.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

  AND spc.DataPlatii
      = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Doar sume pozitive
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND ISNULL(spc.TotalAvans,0) > 0

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Doar state de plata confirmate
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND spc.Status = 2

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Doar carduri valide
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND ISNULL(cb.Valid,0) = 1

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- IBAN obligatoriu
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND NULLIF
      (
          LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.ContIBAN)),
          ''
      ) IS NOT NULL

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Evita dublarea daca plata este deja in flux
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM app.SumaBCR x

      WHERE x.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
        AND x.Anul = @Anul
        AND x.Luna = @Luna

        AND CAST(x.DataPlatii AS DATE)
            = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)

        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(x.TipPlata))
            = LTRIM(RTRIM(@TipPlata))

        AND x.Status IN (2,5,8,9)
  );

-------------------------------------------------
-- SURSA: app.GarantieMateriala
-- TIP PLATA: GARANTII MATERIALE (GAR)
-- BANCA: BCR
-------------------------------------------------

INSERT INTO app.SumaBCR
(
    Marca,
    Nume,
    CNP,
    Cont,
    Suma,
    TipPlata,
    Nume1,
    CNP1,
    Cont1,

    Luna,
    Anul,

    DataPlatii,
    DenumireFisier,

    Recreat,

    Valid,
    MesajValidare,

    CodSucursala,
    Status,

    CreatedDate
)

SELECT
    cl.Marca,
    s.Nume,
    s.CNP,
    cb.ContIBAN,
    cl.RataLunara,
    @TipPlata,

    '"' + ISNULL(s.Nume,'') + '"',
    '"' + ISNULL(s.CNP,'') + '"',
    '"' + ISNULL(cb.ContIBAN,'') + '"',

    cl.Luna,
    cl.Anul,

    @DataPlatii,

    @CodSucursala
        + FORMAT(CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE),'ddMMyy')
        + @CodSursa +'.bcr',

    'NU',

    CASE
        WHEN cb.ContIBAN IS NULL
             OR LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.ContIBAN)) = ''
        THEN 0

        WHEN ISNULL(cb.Valid,0) = 0
        THEN 0

        ELSE 1
    END,

    CASE
        WHEN cb.ContIBAN IS NULL
             OR LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.ContIBAN)) = ''
        THEN 'IBAN lipsa'

        WHEN ISNULL(cb.Valid,0) = 0
        THEN 'IBAN invalid'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END,

    cl.CodSucursala,

    (
        SELECT TOP 1 Id
        FROM app.StatusCalcul
        WHERE Denumire = 'Draft'
    ),

    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.GarantieMateriala cl

INNER JOIN app.CardBCR cb
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.Marca)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Marca))

INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(s.Marca)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Marca))
   AND s.CodSucursala = cl.CodSucursala
   AND s.Luna = cl.Luna
   AND s.Anul = cl.Anul

WHERE cl.Luna = @Luna
  AND cl.Anul = @Anul
  AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  AND ISNULL(cl.RataLunara,0) > 0

  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM app.SumaBCR x
      WHERE x.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
        AND x.Anul = @Anul
        AND x.Luna = @Luna
        AND CAST(x.DataPlatii AS DATE) = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)
        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(x.TipPlata)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@TipPlata))
        AND x.Status IN (2,5,8,9)
  );

-- TIP PLATA: ALIMENTARE SALARII (SAL)
-- BANCA: CEC
-------------------------------------------------

-- INSERT snapshot CEC - SAL
-------------------------------------------------

INSERT INTO app.SumaCEC
(
    Marca,
    Nume,
    CNP,
    Cont,
    Suma,

    Nume1,
    CNP1,
    Cont1,

    Luna,
    Anul,

    TipPlata,
    DataPlatii,
    DenumireFisier,

    Recreat,

    Valid,
    MesajValidare,

    CodSucursala,
    Status,

    CreatedDate
)

SELECT

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Date principale
    -------------------------------------------------
    cl.Marca,

    s.Nume,

    s.CNP,

    cb.ContIBAN,

    cl.NetDePlata,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Campuri export CEC
    -------------------------------------------------
    '"' + ISNULL(s.Nume, '') + '"',

    '"' + ISNULL(s.CNP, '') + '"',

    '"' + ISNULL(cb.ContIBAN, '') + '"',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Perioada payroll
    -------------------------------------------------
    cl.Luna,

    cl.Anul,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Tip plata
    -------------------------------------------------
    @TipPlata,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Data platii
    -------------------------------------------------
    @DataPlatii,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Denumire fisier
    -- CodSucursala + DataPlatii + CodSursa
    -------------------------------------------------
    @CodSucursala
    + FORMAT(CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE), 'ddMMyy')
    + @CodSursa
    + '.cec',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Recreat
    -------------------------------------------------
    'NU',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Valid
    -- Se insereaza numai cardurile valide
    -------------------------------------------------
    1,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Mesaj validare
    -------------------------------------------------
    'OK',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Cod sucursala
    -------------------------------------------------
    cl.CodSucursala,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Status initial SumaCEC = Draft
    -------------------------------------------------
    (
        SELECT TOP 1 Id
        FROM app.StatusCalcul
        WHERE Denumire = 'Draft'
    ),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

INNER JOIN app.CardCEC cb
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.Marca))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Marca))

   AND LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.CodSucursala))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.CodSucursala))

INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(s.Marca))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Marca))

   AND LTRIM(RTRIM(s.CodSucursala))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.CodSucursala))

   AND s.Luna = cl.Luna
   AND s.Anul = cl.Anul

WHERE cl.Luna = @Luna
  AND cl.Anul = @Anul
  AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Lichidarea trebuie sa fie blocata
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND cl.Status = 2

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Doar sume pozitive
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND ISNULL(cl.NetDePlata, 0) > 0

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Doar conturi CEC valide
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND cb.ContIBAN IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.ContIBAN)) <> ''
  AND ISNULL(cb.Valid, 0) = 1

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Nu permitem regenerarea unei plati deja
  -- confirmate, preluate, pregatite sau transmise
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM app.SumaCEC x

      WHERE x.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
        AND x.Anul = @Anul
        AND x.Luna = @Luna

        AND CAST(x.DataPlatii AS DATE)
            = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)

        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(x.TipPlata))
            = LTRIM(RTRIM(@TipPlata))

        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(x.DenumireFisier))
            =
            LTRIM
            (
                RTRIM
                (
                    @CodSucursala
                    + FORMAT
                      (
                          CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE),
                          'ddMMyy'
                      )
                    + @CodSursa
                    + '.cec'
                )
            )

        AND x.Status IN (2, 5, 8, 9)
  );

  -- Doar sume pozitive
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND ISNULL(spc.TotalAvans, 0) > 0

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Prevenire duplicat
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM app.SumaING x

      WHERE x.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
        AND x.Anul = @Anul
        AND x.Luna = @Luna

        AND x.DataPlatii = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)

        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(x.TipPlata))
          = LTRIM(RTRIM(@TipPlata))

        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(x.DenumireFisier))
          =
          LTRIM
          (
              RTRIM
              (
                  @CodSucursala
                  + FORMAT(CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE), 'ddMMyy')
                  + LTRIM(RTRIM(@CodSursa))
                  + '.ing'
              )
          )

        AND x.Status IN (2, 5, 8, 9)
  );

    s.Nume,

-------------------------------------------------
-- SURSA: app.GarantieMateriala
-- TIP PLATA: GARANTII MATERIALE (GAR)
-- BANCA: ALTE
-------------------------------------------------

INSERT INTO app.SumaALTE
(
    Marca,
    Nume,
    CNP,
    Cont,
    Suma,
    TipPlata,
    Nume1,
    CNP1,
    Cont1,
    Luna,
    Anul,
    DataPlatii,
    DenumireFisier,
    Recreat,
    Valid,
    MesajValidare,
    CodSucursala,
    Status,
    CreatedDate
)
SELECT
    gm.Marca,
    s.Nume,
    s.CNP,
    ca.ContIBAN,
    gm.RataLunara,

    @TipPlata,

    '"' + ISNULL(s.Nume, '') + '"',
    '"' + ISNULL(s.CNP, '') + '"',
    '"' + ISNULL(ca.ContIBAN, '') + '"',

    gm.Luna,
    gm.Anul,

    @DataPlatii,

    @CodSucursala
        + FORMAT(CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE), 'ddMMyy')
        + @CodSursa
        + '_alte',

    'NU',

    CASE
        WHEN ca.ContIBAN IS NULL
          OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ca.ContIBAN)) = ''
            THEN CAST(0 AS BIT)

        WHEN ISNULL(ca.Valid, 0) = 0
            THEN CAST(0 AS BIT)

        ELSE CAST(1 AS BIT)
    END,

    CASE
        WHEN ca.ContIBAN IS NULL
          OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ca.ContIBAN)) = ''
            THEN 'IBAN lipsa'

        WHEN ISNULL(ca.Valid, 0) = 0
            THEN 'IBAN invalid'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END,

    gm.CodSucursala,

    (
        SELECT TOP 1 Id
        FROM app.StatusCalcul
        WHERE Denumire = 'Draft'
    ),

    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.GarantieMateriala gm

INNER JOIN app.CardALTE ca
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ca.Marca))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(gm.Marca))

INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(s.Marca))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(gm.Marca))
    AND s.CodSucursala = gm.CodSucursala
    AND s.Luna = gm.Luna
    AND s.Anul = gm.Anul

WHERE gm.Luna = @Luna
  AND gm.Anul = @Anul
  AND gm.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  AND ISNULL(gm.RataLunara, 0) > 0

  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM app.SumaALTE x
      WHERE x.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
        AND x.Anul = @Anul
        AND x.Luna = @Luna
        AND CAST(x.DataPlatii AS DATE)
            = CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)
        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(x.TipPlata))
            = LTRIM(RTRIM(@TipPlata))
        AND x.Status IN (2, 5, 8, 9)
  );
